---
title: Ham Cake
id: MAR-0076
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 40
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g raw ham slices
- 200 g Emmental cheese slices
- 7 potato
- 40 g butter
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Wash the potatoes and cook them in boiling salted water for about 30-35 minutes.
2. Drain them, let them cool, and peel them.
3. Slice the potatoes and arrange them in layers in a mold greased with 20 g of butter, covering each layer with slices of ham and Emmental.
4. Place the remaining butter in pieces on the surface and put in the oven.
5. Cook at 180 °C for about 20 minutes.
